visualReview.scope: Portable rendering and geometry presentation; separate from maximum exterior fidelity approval.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all ten current portable frames in a labeled contact sheet, with lantern details enlarged during iteration. The clock faces, open stages, bells, base and finial remain visible from all four sides. Floating corner ornaments were seated on their cornices, and segmented curved trim was replaced by continuous smooth sweeps before the final captures. Historic facade correspondence remains a separate pending review.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all nine current shared-material frames and full-size lower-lantern and masonry-window views. Four canonical surfaces resolve, cylindrical brick courses wrap continuously, recessed windows retain depth, and scroll/arch trim is continuous. The fixture reports the complete 123692-triangle mesh and successful unload; this is isolated asset review, not a real-site placement capture.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-identity way/57864086 provides the anchor and an undirected footprint axis. Signed facade orientation, asymmetrical buttressing foot and quay/pavement contact need review. The candidate remains inactive; the asset-review fixture is not geographic certification.

fidelityReview.notes: Measured-section exterior study at a documented working height of 42.05 m. The historical 48 m statement conflicts with the section and AHN4 evidence. Refine window distribution, irregular masonry/stone cross-frames, corner volutes, clock surrounds and crown against additional elevations and current facade views. No maximum-fidelity approval is claimed.
